# node_modules — JS-first Node.js shim layer

Paket gaya NPM yang memberi bentuk Node.js di atas engine MochiBerry.
Orientasi dominan: **JS/script/framework** — tapi satu paket boleh tetap
memanggil native (`loadNative()` / `dynalib()`) untuk bagian berat.

Layer sebelah: [`../mochi_modules`](../mochi_modules) = plugin native engine.

| module | status | deskripsi |
|---|---|---|
| `mochinode` | verified | Core loader: require(), loadNative(), resolvePackage, BUILTIN_ALIASES passthrough |
| `mochiglobals` | verified | Installs missing globals: setTimeout/setInterval/clear*, URL, TextEncoder/Decoder, AbortController, structuredClone, fetch, crypto |
| `mochitimers` | verified | Node timers over mbjs:os, also installed as globals |
| `mochicrypto` | verified | node:crypto shim: createHash/createHmac/pbkdf2/Cipheriv/randomBytes over mochicrypto.dll |
| `mochizlib` | verified | node:zlib shim: gzip/gunzip/deflate/inflate + transforms over mochizlib.dll |
| `mochifs` | verified | node:fs shim over mochifs.dll with mbjs:std fallback |
| `mochibuffer` | verified | node:buffer shim (MochiBuffer extends Uint8Array), installs globalThis.Buffer |
| `mochievents` | verified | node:events shim: EventEmitter |
| `mochipath` | verified | node:path shim: join/resolve/dirname/basename/normalize |
| `mochiutil` | verified | node:util shim: format/inspect/promisify |
| `mochistream` | verified | node:stream shim: Readable/Writable/Transform |
| `mochiurl` | verified | node:url shim: URL/URLSearchParams (+ SimpleURL fallback) |
| `mochios` | verified | node:os shim: platform/arch/tmpdir/homedir/cpus/freemem |
| `mochiprocess` | verified | node:process shim: env/argv/arch/hrtime/uptime + globalThis.process |
| `mochimodule` | verified | node:module shim: createRequire() |
| `mochiws` | operational | node:ws / WebSocket shim + httpGet over mochiws.dll (WinHTTP) |
| `mochihttp` | operational | node:http shim: ClientRequest/IncomingMessage, get() over mochiws.httpGet |
| `mochihttps` | stub | node:https shim — request/get emit MOCHI_UNSUPPORTED (no TLS write path yet) |
| `mochiasync_hooks` | stub | node:async_hooks shim: AsyncLocalStorage (single-context, non-async-correct) |
| `mochitls` | stub | node:tls shim: TLSSocket marker only, connect() unsupported |
| `mochinet` | stub | node:net shim: Socket marker + unsupported connect/createServer |
| `mochidiagnostics_channel` | stub | node:diagnostics_channel shim: no-op channel() |
| `mochiperf_hooks` | stub | node:perf_hooks shim: performance passthrough + no-op PerformanceObserver |
| `mochiworker_threads` | stub | node:worker_threads shim: Worker throws unavailable, isMainThread=true |
| `mochijsnative` | broken | AOT/JIT native bridge loader (native probe helper) |
| `mochijsnative_stub` | operational | fallback for mochijsnative when native unavailable |
| `dynalib` | operational | JS API for libdynalib (dynalib(file, offset, symbol, abi, opts)) |
| `events` | operational | stand-in node:events for the express/net stack |
| `express` | operational | Express-compatible router (partial: middleware/body/static still open) |
| `fs` | operational | node:fs entry re-exported from mochifs |
| `net` | operational | node:net entry over mochinode_net.dll |
| `sqlite` | operational | node:sqlite-style shim over mochinode_sqlite.dll (bind parameters not wired) |

## Cara pakai

```js
const { require } = await import('./node_modules/mochinode/index.js');
const crypto = await require('node:crypto');   // -> mochicrypto
const ws = await require('mochiws');
```

`require()` memanggil `ensureGlobals()` dulu, jadi `setTimeout`, `URL`,
`fetch`, `TextEncoder`, `crypto`, dll. terpasang otomatis.
